make_transition_model: build a transition model from config using make_transition_model with action shape and multitask config
DeterministicTransitionModel_forward: build a deterministic transition model that predicts next state mean without uncertainty using forward pass
ProbabilisticTransitionModel_forward: build a probabilistic transition model that predicts next state mean and sigma using forward pass
TransitionModel_sample_prediction: sample a predicted next state from a transition model using the sample_prediction method
DeterministicTransitionModel_get_last_sh: get the last shared layers of a deterministic transition model for multitask weight sharing
